component.name: Greenshot for Linux
component.summary: Take screenshots, annotate them and send them where they belong

description.p: Greenshot captures a region, a window or the whole screen, lets you annotate, highlight or obfuscate parts of it and sends it on: to a file, the clipboard, the printer, an e-mail, Box, Dropbox, Jira, Confluence or your own uploader.

ul.li: An editor with shapes, arrows, text, speech bubbles, step labels, emoji, highlighting, blurring and pixelation
Cropping, crop out with cut edges, torn edges, drop shadows and borders
Text recognition (OCR) and QR codes: read them from the screen, or create them
Recipes: automate what happens with a capture, with a visual editor
A command line, and access for AI tools through an MCP server, which you switch on and allow per program

description.p: This is an independent Linux version of Greenshot for Wayland desktops: Sway, Hyprland and other wlroots compositors, GNOME and KDE. It is not made by the Greenshot team; it reads the settings, files and recipes of Greenshot 1.4 for Windows.
